security_justification.audit_integrity: Contradictory outcomes are refused before sink delivery; no claim that producers tell the truth or commit state proves durability.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Success precedes authorization as in the contract; SDK-only denial follows all contract diagnostics so approved authorization conflicts remain first.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Same-instance bound handles and branded fixture contexts remain authoritative; denial runs after derived-field provenance and cannot mask its diagnostic.
security_justification.concurrency: No concurrency or duplicate-success reservation change; fresh SDK instances isolate matrix rows and no additional mutable state is introduced.
security_justification.confidentiality: Reuse bounded safe errors without event values or caught data; no new diagnostic disclosure or secret access is required.
security_justification.cryptography: No algorithms, identifiers, signatures or key handling change; lookup tables classify existing domain states only.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Return existing fixed code/category/path triples only; no new error code or public type and no echoed caller values.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Node binding receives error-catalog guidance only; frozen contract and structural-only collector admission remain unchanged.
security_justification.fail_posture: All four shared semantic paths fail closed on contradictory pairs with zero sink calls, including historical-event redelivery.
security_justification.lifecycle: Only completed/compensating success and committing denial are judged; terminal transitions, omitted defaults and pending/no-handle behavior stay unchanged.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: One source file and one new top-level test file; preserve #811 source and verification anchors and run the unchanged complete mutation suite.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Derived-field trust-floor checks retain precedence over denial; no transformation-hook or privacy-policy change.
security_justification.resource_retention: Module-scope immutable lookup policy adds no ledger, retention capacity or per-event stored state; ADR-SDK-007 remains unchanged.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No exemption for old events on redelivery; identity, retry semantics and sink behavior remain unchanged apart from refusal.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Caller outcomes cannot contradict operation commit evidence; complete-event producers obey the same pair rules without claiming independent truth verification.
